blocks.content: In this project lesson, you will create a simple progress bar.
A progress bar is a visual indicator of progress, like loading a page or completing a task.
Your animation bar will look like this:
You'll start by building the basic structure of the progress bar and then add an animation to make it visually appealing as it fills up.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
